resources.string: Recovery protection
Verify recovery using your original master password
Verified in this session at %1$s
Recovery protection could not be verified. Existing data was kept. Retry or make an encrypted backup.
Enter your master password to prepare and verify recovery

Verify that your original master password can open the independent recovery material. This does not replace your vault or device keys. A healthy older installation may prepare recovery material during verification.

Keep an independent encrypted backup. Verification applies to the current material and session; it does not guarantee future file integrity or recovery of hardware-bound credentials. Locking or changing the material requires verification again.
Verify recovery protection
Verifying recovery protection…
Recovery material was found. Recovery still requires verification with the original master password.
No independent recovery material was found. Restore the original key environment or verify an encrypted backup in another installation.
Recovery must be prepared again after a credential change. Restore normal access, then verify with your current master password.
This recovery material was explicitly revoked and cannot be used. Keep the original files.
This recovery format is not supported by this version. Keep the files and use a compatible Monica version.
Recovery material is incomplete or invalid. Keep the original files; do not replace them with an empty file or another vault’s material.
Recovery material could not be read. Keep the files, unlock the device and retry.
Recovery material has not been checked. Retry after the device is unlocked and the current operation has finished.
The current system key service cannot find the original key. This alone does not prove the key was permanently deleted.
The system is not ready or a secure operation has not finished. Unlock the device and retry later.
The encrypted settings and recovery state do not match. Keep the original files; do not remove recovery markers to bypass this check.

If this started after changing OMK or another key module, restore the key environment used to create this vault. Removing Monica from a newly added scope may help; it is not correct for every vault. Preserve the module configuration and keys. Do not reinstall modules or reset their seed to experiment.
